$jsonSchema.title: Plan
$jsonSchema.description: One purchase tier on the Plans & Pricing page (apps/sales_page.py TIERS).

_id.description: The tier id: starter, professional, enterprise.

positioning.description: Label above the name: Basic, Most popular, Premium.

monthlyPriceUsd.description: Whole US dollars per month. null = custom quote (no list price).

annualPriceUsd.description: Whole US dollars per year: twelve months for the price of ten. null = custom quote.

inherits.description: Text of the first feature line, e.g. 'Everything in Starter'. null for the lowest tier.

featured.description: true for the highlighted (Most popular) tier.

requiresQuote.description: true when the price is a custom quote.

active.description: false hides the tier from the page.

toolIds.description: _id values of the tools in this tier (not counting the tiers it inherits from).
